name.description: Policy-gradient objective, or 'sft' for supervised fine-tuning on the dataset responses (no rollouts).
name.title: Name

sft_train_on_prompt.description: sft: include prompt tokens in the loss (default: response only).
sft_train_on_prompt.title: Sft Train On Prompt

sft_turns.description: sft: assistant turns of a conversation that carry the loss. 'last': only the final one, earlier turns are context. 'all': every assistant turn (multi-turn and tool-using conversations), except those a row marks with 'weight': 0.
sft_turns.title: Sft Turns

kl_coef.description: Coefficient of the KL penalty to the reference policy (0 disables).
kl_coef.title: Kl Coef

advantage_norm.description: grpo and dapo: normalise rewards within the prompt group, across the batch, or not at all. Not read by rloo, ppo or reinforce, except that verl subtracts the group mean under reinforce when this is 'group'.
advantage_norm.title: Advantage Norm

advantage_std_norm.description: Divide by std in group normalisation (False = Dr.GRPO style).
advantage_std_norm.title: Advantage Std Norm

loss_agg.description: Average the loss over all response tokens, per training sequence first, or per rollout first ('rollout': every episode counts equally however many sequences its turns form).
loss_agg.title: Loss Agg

entropy_coef.description: Weight of the entropy bonus: entropy_coef * entropy is subtracted from the loss.
entropy_coef.title: Entropy Coef

num_epochs.description: Optimizer passes over each rollout batch.
num_epochs.title: Num Epochs

dynamic_sampling.description: Drop groups whose rewards are all identical (DAPO).
dynamic_sampling.title: Dynamic Sampling

credit_assignment.description: Which rewards a response token is credited with. 'episode': the reward of its whole episode, the same advantage for every token. 'turn': the return from its own turn on (later per-turn rewards discounted by gamma; the reward-function score arrives at the final turn), compared with the same turn of the other episodes of its prompt group. See docs/CREDIT_ASSIGNMENT.md.
credit_assignment.title: Credit Assignment

lam.description: GAE lambda (ppo only): 1 = returns minus the value baseline, 0 = one-step TD error.
lam.title: Lam

value_clip.description: ppo only: the value loss also penalises a value estimate clipped to this distance from the estimate the advantages were computed with (null = plain squared error).
value_clip.title: Value Clip

mode.description: Run in-process or on a Ray cluster.
mode.title: Mode

ray_address.description: Ray address ('auto' to join an existing cluster).
ray_address.title: Ray Address

gpus_per_node.description: GPUs on each node; 0 runs on CPU.
gpus_per_node.title: Gpus Per Node

placement.description: Share GPUs between rollout and training (colocated) or split them (disaggregated).
placement.title: Placement

extra.description: Options of the runtime and the weight sync (ray_init, sync_dir, ...).
extra.title: Extra

uri.description: Dataset location: 'hf://org/name' (Hub), 's3://bucket/prefix-or-file' (credentials from AWS_* env vars), a local file/directory (.jsonl/.json/.parquet/.csv/.arrow), or the scheme of a data source that a module in `providers` registers.
uri.title: Uri

split.description: Split name for Hub datasets (ignored for files).
split.title: Split

format.description: 'chat': a messages column; 'prompt_answer': prompt + reference answer columns; 'text': a single prompt column; 'auto' sniffs columns.
format.title: Format

image_field.description: Column(s) holding images (HF Image feature, file path/URI, bytes or base64) attached to the prompt as image content parts. Use '<image>' in prompt_template to position them.
image_field.title: Image Field

response_field.description: Column holding the target response for SFT (defaults to answer_field / the trailing assistant turn).
response_field.title: Response Field

tools_field.description: Column holding the tool schemas (a list of OpenAI-style function schemas, or its JSON string) a chat row's prompts are rendered with. Default: a 'tools' column of a chat dataset when it holds one.
tools_field.title: Tools Field

system_prompt.description: System prompt prepended to every sample.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

prompt_template.description: Python format string applied to the prompt column, e.g. '{prompt}\nThink step by step.'
prompt_template.title: Prompt Template

max_prompt_tokens.description: Samples with longer prompts are dropped.
max_prompt_tokens.title: Max Prompt Tokens

limit.description: Use only the first N samples (after shuffling).
limit.title: Limit

shuffle.description: Shuffle the rows with the run's seed (a streaming source shuffles within a buffer).
shuffle.title: Shuffle

streaming.description: Stream from Hub/S3 instead of materialising locally.
streaming.title: Streaming

eval_split.description: Split of eval_uri that is evaluated.
eval_split.title: Eval Split

max_turns.description: Policy turns an episode may take at most.
max_turns.title: Max Turns

retries.description: Times an episode whose environment failed (a crashed agent, a failing step) is started again.
retries.title: Retries

max_failed_frac.description: Share of a rollout batch's episodes that may fail for good; they are left out of the batch. Above it the run fails. 0 (default): any failed episode fails the run.
max_failed_frac.title: Max Failed Frac

log_every.description: Write metrics every this many steps (the last step is always written).
log_every.title: Log Every

trajectories_per_step.description: Rollouts saved per logged step at most; 0 saves none.
trajectories_per_step.title: Trajectories Per Step

save_transcripts.description: Include the full conversation and per-turn details of every saved rollout.
save_transcripts.title: Save Transcripts

success_threshold.description: Total reward at or above which an episode counts as solved (success-rate and pass@k metrics).
success_threshold.title: Success Threshold

wandb_project.description: Weights & Biases project the metrics are also logged to (needs the wandb package).
wandb_project.title: Wandb Project

tensorboard.description: Also write the metrics as TensorBoard events under <run_dir>/tensorboard.
tensorboard.title: Tensorboard

enabled.description: Train LoRA adapters instead of full parameters.
enabled.title: Enabled

name_or_path.description: Hugging Face model id or local path.
name_or_path.title: Name Or Path

trust_remote_code.description: Let the model repository's own code run when the model is loaded.
trust_remote_code.title: Trust Remote Code

dtype.description: Parameter dtype; 'auto' picks bf16 on accelerators and fp32 on CPU.
dtype.title: Dtype

MtpConfig.description: Multi-token prediction layers of the model (``docs/MTP.md``).

enabled.description: Load the checkpoint's MTP (multi-token prediction) layers next to the policy and keep them in weight sync, checkpoints and the final export. Needs a model that ships MTP layers.
enabled.title: Enabled

rollout.description: Draft tokens with the MTP layers during rollouts (speculative decoding). The policy verifies every draft, so the sampled tokens and their logprobs are the policy's; only speed changes.
rollout.title: Rollout

num_speculative_tokens.description: Tokens drafted per decoding step. Default: one per MTP layer on the hf engine, 1 on vLLM, SGLang's own default.
num_speculative_tokens.title: Num Speculative Tokens

train.description: Train the MTP layers with an auxiliary loss (predict the tokens after the next one) on the response tokens of every batch, in RL and SFT, so drafts keep matching a policy that changes.
train.title: Train

loss_coef.description: Weight of the MTP loss in the total loss.
loss_coef.title: Loss Coef

detach_trunk.description: true: the MTP loss updates the MTP layers only. false: it also flows into the policy's own parameters, as in pretraining.
detach_trunk.title: Detach Trunk

MtpConfig.title: MtpConfig

OffPolicyConfig.description:
Corrections for batches sampled by another policy than the one being updated (stale rollouts
under ``rollout.async_steps_ahead``, engines whose weights or numerics lag): docs/OFF_POLICY.md.

anchor.description: Proximal policy the clipped ratio is anchored on. 'behavior': the policy that sampled the tokens (the engine's log-probs). 'trainer': the trainer's policy when the update on the batch starts (decoupled PPO; one extra forward pass per batch). 'auto': 'trainer' when importance_weights or ratio_mask is set, otherwise the backend's default.
anchor.title: Anchor

importance_weights.description: Weigh the policy loss by the truncated importance ratio between the proximal and the behaviour policy, per token or per training sequence (product of its token ratios).
importance_weights.title: Importance Weights

importance_cap.description: Upper bound of the importance weights (null = untruncated).
importance_cap.title: Importance Cap

ratio_mask.description: Drop from the policy loss the tokens, or whole training sequences, whose proximal/behaviour importance ratio is outside [ratio_mask_low, ratio_mask_high]. 'sequence' tests the product of a sequence's token ratios, 'sequence_mean' their geometric mean.
ratio_mask.title: Ratio Mask

ratio_mask_low.description: Lower bound of the accepted importance ratio.
ratio_mask_low.title: Ratio Mask Low

ratio_mask_high.description: Upper bound of the accepted importance ratio.
ratio_mask_high.title: Ratio Mask High

score_centering.description: Subtract the expected score under the sampling policy from the policy gradient (arXiv:2609.20807). Needs the engine's top-k next-token log-probs and the 'behavior' anchor.
score_centering.title: Score Centering

score_centering_top_k.description: Number of most likely next tokens the engine records per sampled token.
score_centering_top_k.title: Score Centering Top K

OffPolicyConfig.title: OffPolicyConfig

type.description: Reward function name (see /api/system for the list).
type.title: Type

group_size.description: Completions sampled per prompt (G in GRPO).
group_size.title: Group Size

max_new_tokens.description: Tokens a turn may generate at most.
max_new_tokens.title: Max New Tokens

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling threshold; 1.0 turns it off.
top_p.title: Top P

stop.description: Strings at which a turn's generation stops.
stop.title: Stop

tensor_parallel_size.description: GPUs one engine replica spans (tensor parallelism).
tensor_parallel_size.title: Tensor Parallel Size

gpu_memory_utilization.description: Share of a GPU's memory the engine may take (vLLM gpu_memory_utilization, SGLang mem_fraction_static).
gpu_memory_utilization.title: Gpu Memory Utilization

max_model_len.description: Context length the engine is started with (vLLM max_model_len, SGLang context_length). Default: the model's own.
max_model_len.title: Max Model Len

max_context_tokens.description: Context budget of an episode in tokens: no prompt plus completion of a turn may exceed it. A turn's generation is capped to the room that is left, an episode without room for another turn ends, and an agent behind the gateway gets a context_length_exceeded error. Default: trainer.max_seq_len (and rollout.max_model_len when set), so that nothing an episode samples is cut off in training.
max_context_tokens.title: Max Context Tokens

async_steps_ahead.description: Generate up to N batches ahead of training (off-policy staleness bound). 0 = synchronous.
async_steps_ahead.title: Async Steps Ahead

turn_rendering.description: How a multi-turn prompt is built. 'tokens': the sampled tokens of earlier turns stay in the context and only new messages are rendered. 'template': the chat template re-renders the whole conversation every turn.
turn_rendering.title: Turn Rendering

turn_batching.description: How the turns of concurrent episodes reach an engine. 'lockstep': once every running episode has its next prompt, all of them are generated in one call, in a fixed order, so a run repeats for a fixed seed; an episode waits for the slowest environment step of its round. 'arrival': an episode asks as soon as its environment has answered and requests are batched as they arrive: faster when environment steps are slow and uneven, not repeatable. Agent harnesses that drive their own episodes always run the second way.
turn_batching.title: Turn Batching

device.description: Device for the 'hf' backend (cpu/mps/cuda); auto if unset.
device.title: Device

learning_rate.description: Learning rate (its peak under warmup or a schedule).
learning_rate.title: Learning Rate

prompts_per_step.description: Prompts per optimizer step (x group_size = sequences).
prompts_per_step.title: Prompts Per Step

warmup_steps.description: Steps over which the learning rate rises linearly from 0.
warmup_steps.title: Warmup Steps

max_grad_norm.description: Norm the gradient is clipped to at every step.
max_grad_norm.title: Max Grad Norm

gradient_checkpointing.description: Recompute activations in the backward pass instead of storing them: less memory, more compute.
gradient_checkpointing.title: Gradient Checkpointing

scheduler.description: Learning rate after the warmup: constant, or a linear or cosine decay to 0 at the last step.
scheduler.title: Scheduler

eval_every.description: Evaluate on data.eval_uri every this many steps. Null, or no eval_uri: no evaluation during the run.
eval_every.title: Eval Every

seed.description: Seed of the run: Python and torch are seeded with it at the start (a resumed run takes the state of the generators from its checkpoint), and data sources and backends receive it.
seed.title: Seed

providers.description: Modules imported before the run builds its components. Each exposes register(registry) and may add rewards, environments, engines, trainers or other components under names the config can then use. They are imported from the working directory or the Python path.
providers.title: Providers
